title: KARMA — Component Contract
description: CLI, State Machine, FalsificationGate, Learning Engine. The evidence-first layer that validates outputs as evidence producers, not finished truths. Asks 'Is it true?'

component.name: KARMA
component.description: Empfängt Handoff von Promtguard. FalsificationGate validiert Outputs. Experience Store speichert immutable. Reward Model bewertet. Learning Engine verbessert. Orchestriert goal-chain als Tool Belt.

input.title: KARMA Input Contract
input.description: Receives structured handoff from Promtguard. Every input is treated as evidence to be falsified, not truth to be accepted.

handoff.description: Promtguard R04 handoff including task context and agent routing

claims.description: Claims to be falsified by the FalsificationGate

run_manifest_ref.description: Reference to the shared Run Manifest (session.json) pipeline_run_id

output.title: KARMA Output Contract
output.description: Falsification results, experience records, reward scores, and goal-chain triggers.

falsification_results.description: Results of the FalsificationGate for each claim

experience_records.description: Immutable experience entries in the Experience Store

reward_report.description: Reward Model evaluation for this turn

goalchain_triggers.description: Skills/TIDs triggered via goal-chain Tool Belt

knowledge_graph_update.description: Updates to the Knowledge Graph based on new evidence

state.title: KARMA Persisted State
state.description: Schema-versioned SQLite with migrations. Immutable Experience Store enables replay.

replay_capability.description: Immutable Experience Store: wenn das Reward-Modell sich ändert, können alle historischen Erfahrungen durch die neuen Regeln laufen. Auditierbar. Enterprise-Grade.

falsification_gate.title: FalsificationGate — Core Primitive
falsification_gate.description: Treats outputs as evidence producers, not finished truths. Claims exist with status lifecycle: unverified → supported → confirmed | conflicted. The gate is a Grundbedingung, not a plugin.

needs_engine.title: Needs Engine — Safety Stop
needs_engine.description: Motivation < 0.3 → 'Nicht anfassen'. Agent stops when consistently performing poorly. 3x Reward < 0.20 triggers safety stop.
